# Nurture The Roots™

> Evidence-based postpartum and newborn development support in the San Francisco Bay Area, led by Ashlee McKenzie.

Nurture The Roots™ helps families through the fourth trimester with warm, clear, developmental support — grounded in newborn communication, cues + states, developmental rhythms, responsive care, and early regulation. Services include postpartum doula support, newborn care specialist support, and fourth trimester coaching across the San Francisco Bay Area.
